title: Rick Doty's later claims of alien races and crashes

tellings.quote: So, so, so, so Rick Dodie then comes out after this whole saga and he says that I am now on the side of the truth and you see him on, you know, UFO Twitter or whatever and you see him, you know, getting interviewed on Gaia and, you know, saying we have this many alien races and these were these crashes that really happened.

plain: After being caught up in an old saga of UFO deception, a former Air Force man named Rick Doty came out saying "I am now on the side of the truth," and began telling people on UFO Twitter and on Gaia, a streaming service for paranormal shows, that there are this many alien races and that certain crashes really happened. Michels tells this himself on an episode with the writer Greg Bishop, who wrote about a man driven to breakdown by such stories. He tells it to show how hard it is to know what to make of Doty's later claims.
